predict.question: You start two toy clocks together. Yours advances 1.2 ticks for every step of the reference clock. After 10 reference steps, how many ticks has yours accumulated?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Elapsed time can differ between clocks in different physical conditions.
modelBoundary: The prescribed rates give {A} and {B}. Matching initial readings do not prevent an accumulating gap when rates differ.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This integrates prescribed readings only. No relativity equation, gravitational effect or clock measurement is supplied.
